Full Metal Alchemist and Full Metal Alchemist: Brotherhood. Watch the former, then the latter. Towards the beginning they'll appear to be nearly the same anime, but a bit further in they split--the first FMA was created while the manga was still being released, so it had to make it's own ending. Brotherhood is based off the finished manga. Both are completely worth the watch.

I'm also a fan of the Monogatari series, but you may have to look up the order to watch them in due to weird naming systems (Bakemonogatari, Nisemonogatari, Nekomonogatari, Bakemonogatari Second Season, Hanamonogatari, and Tsukimonogatari).

Please use the Recommendation Megathread, listed in The Super Master Thread, in order to ask for recommendations. Thank you for your cooperation.

• Shinsekai Yori - My favorite anime, it's basically an anime version of Brave New World. Contains NO "anime tropes" or fanservice, a very dark and very great story, fantastic worldbuilding, and the final episodes are nothing short of amazing.
  • Gurren Lagann, if you enjoy action that gets continuously crazier and and bigger in scope as the anime goes on, this is one for you.
  • Fate series - One of the most popular and definitely the most beautiful anime series (*cough*Ignore the first Fate/stay night by Deen*cough*) My personal order would be to start off Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works (TV) season 1 (well, the prologue and then Season 1), to get the basics of the Fate universe, and then watch both seasons of Fate/Zero. Then watch Prisma Illya. Yes, it's magical girl Fate, but I think it's good and the third season (2wei Herz) will be starting in a few days. I'd say watch it before finishing the second season of because it makes some parts of it more meaningful. Finally finish the second season of Unlimited Blade Works. Warning: The Heaven's Feel route of Fate, which I've seen many people call the best route of Fate/stay night, will be getting a movie soon. Fate/Zero does spoil some of it, but I can't say how much, or if Prisma Illya does too, because I've never played the visual novel.
  • Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood as /u/PeacefulCamisado said.
  • Steins;Gate - It's an anime about a mad scientist who turns his microwave into a time machine, and it's rated #2 on MAL for good reason.
  • Psycho-Pass is a dystopian sci-fi crime show free of the standard anime tropes. Just ignore the second season.
  • Kill la Kill
  • Angel Beats!
  • Madoka Magica and its third movie
